data.sql:
CREATE TRIGGER payments_immutable BEFORE UPDATE ON payments
WHEN NEW.id IS NOT OLD.id OR NEW.charge_id IS NOT OLD.charge_id
  OR NEW.amount_minor IS NOT OLD.amount_minor OR NEW.paid_at IS NOT OLD.paid_at
  OR NEW.note IS NOT OLD.note OR NEW.batch_id IS NOT OLD.batch_id
  OR OLD.voided_at IS NOT NULL OR NEW.voided_at IS NULL
BEGIN
  SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'El pago histórico solo puede anularse una vez.');
END;

data.name: payment_batches_immutable
data.sql:
CREATE TRIGGER payment_batches_immutable BEFORE UPDATE ON payment_batches
WHEN NEW.id IS NOT OLD.id OR NEW.client_id IS NOT OLD.client_id
  OR NEW.paid_at IS NOT OLD.paid_at OR NEW.total_minor IS NOT OLD.total_minor
  OR OLD.voided_at IS NOT NULL OR NEW.voided_at IS NULL
  OR (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM payments WHERE batch_id = OLD.id) NOT BETWEEN 2 AND 12
  OR NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM payments WHERE batch_id = OLD.id AND voided_at IS NULL)
BEGIN
  SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'El grupo completo solo puede anularse una vez.');
END;

data.sql:
CREATE TRIGGER charges_preserve_paid_history BEFORE UPDATE ON charges
WHEN (EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM payments WHERE charge_id = OLD.id)
  AND (NEW.id IS NOT OLD.id OR NEW.client_id IS NOT OLD.client_id OR NEW.period_key IS NOT OLD.period_key))
  OR (NEW.amount_minor IS NOT OLD.amount_minor
    AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM payments WHERE charge_id = OLD.id AND voided_at IS NULL))
BEGIN
  SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'El cargo conserva su historial de pagos.');
END;

sql.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "clients" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY CHECK (length(trim(id)) > 0), "full_name" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(trim(full_name)) > 0), "phone" TEXT, "address" TEXT, "monthly_fee_minor" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (typeof(monthly_fee_minor) = 'integer' AND monthly_fee_minor >= 0), "status" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (status IN ('active', 'suspended', 'archived')), "notes" TEXT, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "archived_at" INTEGER, "billing_start_period" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (billing_start_period GLOB '[0-9][0-9][0-9][0-9]-[0-9][0-9]' AND substr(billing_start_period, 1, 4) >= '0001' AND substr(billing_start_period, 6, 2) BETWEEN '01' AND '12'), CHECK((status = 'archived')=(archived_at IS NOT NULL)));
CREATE INDEX clients_status ON clients (status)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "devices" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY CHECK (length(trim(id)) > 0), "client_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES clients(id)ON DELETE RESTRICT, "type" TEXT NOT NULL, "mac_address" TEXT CHECK (mac_address IS NULL OR mac_address GLOB '[0-9A-F][0-9A-F]:[0-9A-F][0-9A-F]:[0-9A-F][0-9A-F]:[0-9A-F][0-9A-F]:[0-9A-F][0-9A-F]:[0-9A-F][0-9A-F]'), "notes" TEXT, "ip_address" TEXT);
CREATE INDEX devices_client ON devices (client_id)
CREATE INDEX devices_mac ON devices (mac_address)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "charges" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY CHECK (length(trim(id)) > 0), "client_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES clients(id)ON DELETE RESTRICT, "period_key" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (period_key GLOB '[0-9][0-9][0-9][0-9]-[0-9][0-9]' AND substr(period_key, 1, 4) >= '0001' AND substr(period_key, 6, 2) BETWEEN '01' AND '12'), "collection_date" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (collection_date GLOB '[0-9][0-9][0-9][0-9]-[0-9][0-9]-[0-9][0-9]' AND date(collection_date, '+0 days') IS NOT NULL AND date(collection_date, '+0 days') = collection_date), "suspension_candidate_date" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (suspension_candidate_date = period_key || '-03'), "amount_minor" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (typeof(amount_minor) = 'integer' AND amount_minor >= 0), "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, UNIQUE(client_id, period_key));
CREATE INDEX charges_period ON charges (period_key)
CREATE INDEX charges_candidate_date ON charges (suspension_candidate_date)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "payment_batches" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY CHECK (length(trim(id)) > 0), "client_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES clients(id)ON DELETE RESTRICT, "paid_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "total_minor" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (typeof(total_minor) = 'integer' AND total_minor >= 0), "voided_at" INTEGER);
CREATE INDEX payment_batches_client ON payment_batches (client_id, paid_at)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "payments" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY CHECK (length(trim(id)) > 0), "charge_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES charges(id)ON DELETE RESTRICT, "amount_minor" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (typeof(amount_minor) = 'integer' AND amount_minor >= 0), "paid_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "note" TEXT, "voided_at" INTEGER, "batch_id" TEXT REFERENCES payment_batches(id)ON DELETE RESTRICT);
CREATE INDEX payments_charge ON payments (charge_id)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX payments_one_active ON payments (charge_id) WHERE voided_at IS NULL
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX payments_batch_charge ON payments (batch_id, charge_id)

CREATE TRIGGER payments_match_batch BEFORE INSERT ON payments WHEN NEW.batch_id IS NOT NULL AND(NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM payment_batches AS b JOIN charges AS c ON c.client_id = b.client_id WHERE b.id = NEW.batch_id AND c.id = NEW.charge_id AND b.paid_at = NEW.paid_at AND(b.voided_at IS NULL OR NEW.voided_at IS NOT NULL)AND NEW.amount_minor <= b.total_minor - (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(amount_minor), 0) FROM payments WHERE batch_id = b.id)) OR (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM payments WHERE batch_id = NEW.batch_id) >= 12)BEGIN SELECT RAISE (ABORT, 'El pago no corresponde al grupo.');END

CREATE TRIGGER payments_exact_amount BEFORE INSERT ON payments WHEN NEW.voided_at IS NULL AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM charges WHERE id = NEW.charge_id AND amount_minor = NEW.amount_minor) BEGIN SELECT RAISE (ABORT, 'El importe debe coincidir con un cargo existente.');END

CREATE TRIGGER payments_immutable BEFORE UPDATE ON payments WHEN NEW.id IS NOT OLD.id OR NEW.charge_id IS NOT OLD.charge_id OR NEW.amount_minor IS NOT OLD.amount_minor OR NEW.paid_at IS NOT OLD.paid_at OR NEW.note IS NOT OLD.note OR NEW.batch_id IS NOT OLD.batch_id OR OLD.voided_at IS NOT NULL OR NEW.voided_at IS NULL BEGIN SELECT RAISE (ABORT, 'El pago histórico solo puede anularse una vez.');END

CREATE TRIGGER payment_batches_immutable BEFORE UPDATE ON payment_batches WHEN NEW.id IS NOT OLD.id OR NEW.client_id IS NOT OLD.client_id OR NEW.paid_at IS NOT OLD.paid_at OR NEW.total_minor IS NOT OLD.total_minor OR OLD.voided_at IS NOT NULL OR NEW.voided_at IS NULL OR (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM payments WHERE batch_id = OLD.id) NOT BETWEEN 2 AND 12 OR NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM payments WHERE batch_id = OLD.id AND voided_at IS NULL) BEGIN SELECT RAISE (ABORT, 'El grupo completo solo puede anularse una vez.');END
CREATE TRIGGER payment_batches_void_children AFTER UPDATE OF voided_at ON payment_batches BEGIN UPDATE payments SET voided_at = NEW.voided_at WHERE batch_id = NEW.id AND voided_at IS NULL;END

CREATE TRIGGER charges_preserve_paid_history BEFORE UPDATE ON charges WHEN(EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM payments WHERE charge_id = OLD.id) AND(NEW.id IS NOT OLD.id OR NEW.client_id IS NOT OLD.client_id OR NEW.period_key IS NOT OLD.period_key))OR(NEW.amount_minor IS NOT OLD.amount_minor AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM payments WHERE charge_id = OLD.id AND voided_at IS NULL))BEGIN SELECT RAISE (ABORT, 'El cargo conserva su historial de pagos.');END

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "app_settings" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY CHECK (id = 1), "business_name" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'Mi Red' CHECK (length(trim(business_name)) > 0), "currency_label" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "default_calling_code" TEXT, "notifications_enabled" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE CHECK (notifications_enabled IN (0, 1)), "last_backup_at" INTEGER);
